newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian man killed in van explosion.
newsitem.headline: Australian man killed in van explosion.

text.p: An Australian man was killed, his parents injured and up to 40 houses damaged on Friday when a van exploded in a normally quiet Sydney street, police said.
The man, a plumber, died instantly when his van exploded in the driveway of a home in the North Ryde suburb.
Police said the explosion may have been caused by a cigarette the man was smoking as he opened the van door igniting liquefied petroleum gas leaking from a tank in the back.
The man's parents were taken to a nearby hospital for treatment to facial injuries, police said.
About 40 neighbouring houses were slightly damaged in the blast, which was heard up to 20 km (12 miles) away.
